idle.desc: Ninja crouch: low, kunai reversed; spins the lead kunai.

idle_flourish.desc: Shoulder roll and hop; plays every 6-10 s while idle.

walk.desc: Stride-locked walk: contact, down, passing; planted foot does not slide.

dash.desc: Low dash forward that covers real ground, with dust and speed lines.

backdash.desc: Evasive hop back with an afterimage trail.

turn.desc: Pivot to face the other way.

jump.desc: Neutral jump: load, push off, rise, tuck at the apex, reach for the floor, squash on landing.

jab.desc: Fast lead-hand thrust. Light hit, small hit-stop.

cross.desc: Big diagonal power slash. Medium hit, forces a block-stagger.

uppercut.desc: Rising launcher slash. Pops the opponent up.

low_kick.desc: Sweep along the ground with a hip turn. Trips guard-high opponents.

roundhouse.desc: High kick with a full hip turn. Heavy hit, big hit-stop, held follow-through.

ground_pound.desc: Codex's heavy leaping slam with a ground shockwave.

deploy.desc: Types a command and hits ENTER: fires a ">_" bolt across the taskbar.

block_hit.desc: Guard absorbs a hit with a flash.

parry.desc: Swat the strike aside with a flash. Counter window.

hit.desc: Head snap first, body follows, overshoots forward, settles.

hit_heavy.desc: Slides back, arms fly, wobbles forward, settles.

knockdown.desc: Falls through an arc, flattens on impact, bounces once.

dizzy.desc: Stagger with stars. Used when a fighter is near its limit.

ko.desc: Knocked out; stars orbit. Shown when a plan limit is hit.

victory.desc: Hood back, arms crossed, two slow nods.

taunt.desc: Come-on beckon. Used when the other fighter's idle too long.

bow.desc: Respect bow before and after a bout.

highfive.desc: Jump high-five. Both finished at the same time.

type.desc: Typing on an air keyboard. Used for long edit streaks.

review.desc: Strokes chin, reads the diff. Played when visiting a finished partner.

wait.desc: Foot tap, hands on hips: waiting for input or approval.

sleep.desc: Sitting nap. No session in 30 minutes.

sudo.desc: "$reverse": raises a giant $ and powers up with elevated permissions.

handoff_give.desc: Holds out a finished diff. The writer hands work to the reviewer.

handoff_take.desc: Reaches out and takes the diff.

console.desc: Pats the other fighter on the shoulder after a KO.

spiral_orb.desc: Spins a sphere of energy in one hand, dashes in with afterimages and drives it home in a spiral burst.

mirror_images.desc: Cross-finger hand sign: three dithered clones rush the opponent.

chain_pull.desc: Slings the rear kunai out on its chain, then yanks the opponent in.

kunai_toss.desc: Cocks a kunai behind the ear and flings it across the gap.

riposte.desc: Riposte: a reverse-grip stab with the rear kunai.

air_slash.desc: Jumps after a launched opponent and strikes down through it in mid-air.

spike.desc: Leaps, raises the weapon overhead and spikes the airborne opponent into the ground.

throw.desc: Grabs the opponent, hoists it overhead and slams it down.

shadow_step.desc: Bursts through the opponent and stops on the far side; the cut lands a beat later.

guard_break.desc: A long heavy wind-up, then the pommel breaks the guard open.

taunt2.desc: Spins a kunai round one finger and points it at the opponent.

launched.desc: Launched: popped up and hanging in the air, open for a juggle.

spiked.desc: Spiked: slammed out of the air, bounces once and lies there.

thrown.desc: Thrown: grabbed, hoisted overhead and slammed flat.

pulled.desc: Pulled: yanked in by a chain and stumbles forward.

guard_crush.desc: Guard crushed: the guard flies open and the fighter staggers, wide open.

hit_high.desc: Hit high: the head snaps back first, the arms follow.

hit_low.desc: Hit low: doubles over the blow, knees buckle.

hit_back.desc: Hit from behind: pitched forward, stumbles, catches itself.

clash.desc: Clash: the weapons lock with a spark, a straining push, then both shove off.

credits: Animation reference & inspiration: LuizMelo (Martial Hero, CC0), Mattz Art / xzany (Samurai pack), GandalfHardcore (Archer pack). All frames are original; see docs/CREDITS.md.

schema_notes.hitstop_ms: per move: how long both fighters should freeze when hit_frame lands (light 150, medium 180, heavy 220, ultimate 260-320).
schema_notes.shake: per move, optional {frames, amp}: screen shake the fighter itself asks for on its hit_frame (amp in px at this res).
schema_notes.smear_frames: per move, optional: frame indices drawn as smears (one-frame motion arcs); play them short (<= 50 ms), never hold them.
schema_notes.credits: top level: the reference-pack credit line to show in-game.
schema_notes.type: V7, per move: what the move is to the choreographer (string, riposte, air, spike, throw, through, guard_break, pull, gust, boomerang, taunt; reactions launched, air_hit, spiked, thrown, pulled, guard_crush).
schema_notes.family: V7, per move: the weapon family it belongs to (blade, dual, polearm, staff, chain, bow, fans, heavy).
schema_notes.input: V7, per move: the fighting-game input label shown in the move list (decoration; nothing reads it as input).
schema_notes.armor: V7, per move: true = a light hit during the wind-up does not make the fighter flinch.
schema_notes.pull_frame: V7, per move: the frame the chain yanks the opponent in.
schema_notes.catch_frame: V7, per move: the frame a thrown boomerang projectile is caught again.
schema_notes.cancel_frame: V7, per move: in a string, the next hit may start at this frame (the rest of the move is cancelled).
schema_notes.lock_frame: V7, per move: the frame two clashing weapons meet (the clash row).
schema_notes.hit: V7, per move: slash / blunt / pierce: which contact spark the engine draws.
schema_notes.height: V7, per move: high / mid / low / back: which directional reaction the defender plays.
schema_notes.combo: V7, top level: the character's 3-hit string, played with cancel timing.
schema_notes.grip: V8 forge, per move: one entry per frame for the front (main) weapon hand, [x, y, angle_deg, hand] or null when no weapon is held (a thrown chakram).  x = px right of the anchor column CENTRE (anchor.R + 0.5) in the right-facing sheet; y = px below the top of the ground_y row (negative = up); for the left-facing sheet negate x and use 180 - angle.  angle = screen degrees of the rendered weapon axis from the grip toward the tip (0 = forward, -90 = up; a bow: the arrow direction, the bow stands across it; a chakram: toward the ring centre).  hand 'f' (front) / 'b'.  Pair it with sheet_unarmed*.png to draw another weapon in the hand.
schema_notes.grip2: V8 forge, per move: the same for the back hand when it holds a second weapon (dual) or the grip of a two-handed weapon (same angle as grip), else null per frame.
schema_notes.sheets_unarmed: V8 forge, top level: the same cells, rows and frames with the held weapon(s), their swing crescents and streaks and a nocked string / arrow not drawn (the hands still close round the empty grip).
schema_notes.air: V8, per airborne move: the trajectory the engine draws, [[t_ms, h], [t_ms, h, ease], ...]; t_ms on the row clock (frame starts from the ms values), h = RES 1 design px above the floor (the same at every res; multiply by res), ease of the segment ending at that key: 'o' rise, 'i' fall, 'h' hang, else linear.  Before the first key the first h, after the last key the last h (a row may end in the air).  The frames carry only the pose.
